Samuel Sledzieski

Sam is an Incoming Assistant Professor in the Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute at UC San Diego. Prior to joining HDSI, he was a postdoc at the Flatiron Institute Center for Computational Biology and Princeton University’s Lewis Sigler Institute. Sam has held research positions at Microsoft Research and the Centre Scientifique de Monaco. He received his PhD and SM in Computer Science from MIT, and his BS in Computer Science from the University of Connecticut. He is a recipient of the National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship.
